theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_dlc_cone_density_function
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → (∃ p ∈ C.support, p ≠ 0) → ∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ y : Euclid P, HasMassDensity C y (Θ y)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuous Θ ∧ (∀ q ∈ C.support, q ≠ 0 → ∃ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ Θ q = (m : ℝ)) ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid P), 0 < s → Θ (s • x) = Θ x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
